components.css: .ds-sleeve{display:block;background:#ff763c;color:#3b1937;padding:25px 24px;min-height:240px;transform:rotate(-1deg);box-shadow:0 8px 16px #5e243915;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow .45s}.ds-sleeve h2{font:800 80px/.95 Bricolage,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:0}.ds-sleeve p{font:17px/1.45 Archivo,sans-serif;margin:13px 0 0}.ds-sleeve:hover{transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(0);box-shadow:0 17px 24px #5e24392a}.ds-sleeve:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #3b1937;outline-offset:6px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-sleeve{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
A personal software record shop: warm pink ground, plum ink, expressive Bricolage lettering, and a varied wall of software sleeves. Real product screenshots and a contained mascot make each project tangible.

The system balances playful display with practical catalogue notes. Unequal widths, modest rotations, and soft shadows suggest objects being browsed; fine rules and calm Archivo prose keep the complete collection readable.
keyCharacteristics: Pink ground and plum reading ink with individually colored sleeves.
Self-hosted Bricolage display and Archivo reading type.
Unequal, slightly rotated sleeves followed by open catalogue rows.
Native links, visible keyboard focus, and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Sleeve Color Rule
rules.body: Use the established colored fields to distinguish projects; keep long reading copy in plum ink on pink.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Bricolage names and introduces the work; Archivo explains it.

rules.name: The Soft Object Rule
rules.body: Use slight rotation and diffuse shadows for sleeves, while catalogue rows remain flat and ruled.

dos: Do retain real product imagery and its provenance.
Do preserve unequal sleeve proportions and readable responsive reflows.
Do use native links with visible focus and reduced-motion support.
Do keep availability labels informational and separate from project links.
donts: Don't replace the collection with identical framed cards.
Don't use hard offset shadows in place of the built diffuse sleeve shadows.
Don't turn status pills into controls or link unavailable private projects.
